title: Convert a legacy MSBuild project to SDK-style
description: Rewrites a non-SDK-style .csproj (the old 2003 MSBuild XML format) into the modern SDK-style form (<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">), preserving the existing TargetFrameworkVersion where possible (e.g. net472) so this can land as its own phase before any framework retargeting. This is a pure text rewrite of the project file -- it does not touch source files and does not invoke a package manager, which is why it is file-only rather than package-manager-mutating.

parameters.name: csproj_path
parameters.description: Path to the .csproj file to rewrite.

parameters.name: target_framework
parameters.description: The TargetFramework moniker to write (e.g. net472, net8.0). Defaults to the closest equivalent of the project's existing TargetFrameworkVersion.

notes: Does not by itself resolve incompatible-api findings or migrate packages.config -- those are separate templates, on purpose, so each phase's declared scope and side-effect class stay accurate (PLAN-5, INTEGRITY-8).
